rationale: The 'current program' shown (p0) is missing two changes already validated in the lineage: (1) using fused scaled_dot_product_attention for the causal self-attention forward pass during training (numerically identical, just faster/more stable, letting the larger model train within the time cap), and (2) the larger-capacity/higher-LR config (n_layer 6, lr 2e-3, warmup 300) that took p0's 4.6433 down to 4.5793. I reapply both as a baseline, then add a new, independent idea on top: decoupled weight decay (exclude 1D params - LayerNorm scale/bias - from decay, apply weight_decay=0.1 only to >=2D weight matrices including the tied embedding). The training report for p0 shows the train-val gap (0.17) still slightly widening in the last 20% of training, a classic sign of memorization given each token is seen ~2x; weight decay directly penalizes weight magnitude and is the standard fix, and by excluding LayerNorm/bias we avoid the failure mode that made p3's coarse decay change (decay on everything, combined with beta2 and clipping changes) look bad - here decay is isolated and applied surgically. This is a well-understood mechanism distinct from anything already tried (p2-p5 either changed lr schedule, MLP structure, or position encoding, not decoupled decay).
